text: Consider singleton MCP server with multiplexed transport (HTTP/SSE) instead of per-client stdio processes. Currently each MCP client (VS Code, Copilot CLI) spawns its own backlogit mcp process, each with an independent sql.DB connection pool against the same backlogit.db. A single long-lived server process with HTTP or SSE transport would eliminate multi-process SQLite contention entirely. NOTE: This is a contingency item -- only pursue if fixes 1-4 (busy_timeout increase, write-retry wrapper, BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions, batched rehydration) prove insufficient to address concurrent session reliability. TRIAGE 2026-04-23: All four fixes shipped in 031-F (032-S). Contingency trigger condition not met. Deprioritized to low -- revisit only if multi-process contention recurs under real workloads. Effort: significant -- requires transport layer refactoring and process lifecycle management. Impact: high if needed -- eliminates the root cause of multi-process contention.

ENHANCEMENT (design-gated): Durable per-artifact-type high-water-mark counter to prevent reuse of archived ordinals that are temporarily out of the index's view.

CONTEXT: Split out of the root-ID-conflict-integrity feature (stash 0F65FBC9) during Stage plan-review on 2026-06-23. The acute data-loss/silent-reuse paths are closed without it by the pre-write canonical uniqueness guard + archive overwrite refusal. This counter is belt-and-suspenders for the narrow window where a canonical file (archived or on another branch) is not visible to allocation.

BLOCKING OPEN DESIGN DECISION (operator): Git-committed counter (visible across clones but merge-conflict-prone on every allocation, and still branch-local until merge) vs. local-only counter (conflict-free but blind to other branches). Resolve before building.

REVIEWER CONSTRAINTS (carry forward):
- The counter store MUST be a durable, human-readable file under .backlogit (Constitution IX): atomic tmp+rename write, stable/sorted ordering to minimize merge conflicts.
- It MUST NOT live in the ephemeral SQLite index (backlogit.db) — Rehydrate clears+rebuilds that, which would wipe the high-water-mark and couple allocation correctness to cache lifecycle.
- It MUST be seeded/reconciled from the canonical max across ALL artifactSearchDirs (queue + archive + routed dirs), and degrade safely (fall back to canonical scan) if missing/stale.
- Confirm it is genuinely additive over a single-pass canonical-max scan before building; document the precise out-of-view window it protects (avoid premature abstraction).
- Depends on the allocation pre-write guard task in the root-ID-conflict feature.

LINKS: follow-up to stash 0F65FBC9; see docs/decisions/2026-06-23-root-id-conflict-integrity-deliberation.md (Decision) and docs/exec-plans/2026-06-23-root-id-conflict-integrity-plan.md (U5 + Plan Review).

Optimize CreateArtifact canonical-uniqueness scan for bulk-create flows (066-S review P2). scanCanonicalArtifacts walks+parses every queue/archive .md on each CreateArtifact call; bulk callers (internal/core/migrate.go external import loop, internal/stash harvest) and large mature backlogs incur O(files) per create -> O(N^2). Suggested: scan once per batch and pass the canonical map in, or memoize within a create batch; single interactive creates are fine. Source: 066-S review of feat/066-root-id-integrity.

Refactor internal/db logging to dependency-inject a *slog.Logger into Rehydrate/warnOnDuplicateSourceIDs (and related db functions) so tests can capture log output without mutating the global slog default via slog.SetDefault. Optional design improvement raised in PR #132 Copilot review (066.004-T). Not a flakiness defect: go test isolates packages in separate processes and the existing test is sequential with t.Cleanup restore. Tracking as a future test-ergonomics/observability cleanup across the db package.

ENHANCEMENT (forward-UX, low priority): Surface the covering feature ID in shipment listings/views so the benign shipment#-vs-feature# numbering offset is not confusing. Context: shipment IDs and feature IDs use independent monotonic counters, so a queued shipment NNN-S commonly carries feature (NNN+1)-F (e.g. 060-S->061-F, 061-S->062-F; precedent: shipped 057-S->058-F). Determined benign (no manifest rewrite) in docs/decisions/2026-06-25-shipment-manifest-drift-determination-deliberation.md (stash B8FF7590). The durable, safe fix is a FORWARD display convention only -- e.g. shipment list/get and the MCP equivalents should show the covering feature ID/title alongside each shipment -- NEVER a retroactive manifest/title rewrite. Scope: read-only presentation layer in internal/cli + internal/mcp shipment views; no manifest data mutation.

docline ValidateFields: upgrade from contract-field-presence checks to full JSON-schema validation against schemas/docline/base-frontmatter-v1.schema.json (pattern/minLength/additionalProperties enforcement at lint time). docline ApplyMigration TOCTOU: re-read each file at apply time and recompute the After bytes (or verify Before still matches on disk) instead of writing the plan-time After, so concurrent edits between plan and apply cannot be clobbered. Source: docs/closure/2026-06-25-docline-frontmatter-adversarial-review.md (L4, 065-S run-1 adversarial review).

Decide permanent disposition of the 2 malformed archived_from records (038-DL, 039-DL, value 'done', not a markdown path). Surfaced by 'doctor --check-archived-from' as archived_from_malformed on every run; intentionally flag-only (never auto-repaired) per operator decision in 067-S. Options for Stage to triage: (a) clear the bogus archived_from field, (b) stamp the canonical .backlogit/queue/<id>.md restore path, or (c) keep flag-only and document as accepted. Source: post-merge closure 067-S (docs/closure/2026-06-27-067-S-archived-from-integrity-closure.md); runbook docs/closure/2026-06-26-archived-from-migration-closure.md.
